name: Bitrefill
summary: Gift cards, mobile top-ups, eSIMs and some bill payments in 170+ countries, bought with cryptocurrency (Bitcoin, Lightning, USDC, USDT and others) or a pre-funded balance. Four documented agent paths: a hosted eCommerce MCP server (OAuth sign-in or an API key from an account), a REST API (Personal key, or Business Basic auth by application), an agent skill package with a CLI, and an x402 storefront at api.bitrefill.com/x402 that needs no Bitrefill account: browse for USDC micro-fees per call, or sign in once with a wallet signature (SIWX) and browse free, then pay each invoice in USDC.

agentAccess.notes: Re-measured 2026-09-21, no credentials, no payment: all 11 documented x402 routes answer 402, none 401 and none data; the 3 routes documented free answer 402 with an empty accepts array and a sign-in-with-x challenge. MCP initialize and REST ping answer 401 (2026-09-11, re-read 09-18).

jobs.summary: Vendor's llms.txt: agents can search products, check prices and complete full purchases of gift cards, payment cards, mobile top-ups and eSIMs via MCP or REST API, delivered instantly; the skill and x402 storefront add a no-account path paid from a wallet. Claim only; no purchase was made.

payments.notes: Re-measured 2026-09-21, no payment made: every priced x402 route quotes the vendor's published price (2000 units of USDC = $0.002; 1000 = $0.001) under scheme exact, on Base, Arbitrum, Polygon and Solana, unchanged since 09-11. invoice/pay quotes scheme upto at 1000 USDC when no invoice resolves.
